facts.fact: FAO states the agricultural statistics plan SPARS 2026-2031 is being aligned with South Sudan's Second National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS II), treating NSDS II as an existing national framework; no period or adoption date is given, so the document's published date is used.
